Walking Whale Design System

元件與頁面模式

每個元件都從 components 與 patterns 目錄裡的範例檔直接渲染，中英並排。範例本身通過輸出驗證器：只用系統的 class，沒有 style 屬性，也沒有自訂顏色。

長文開頭的三個重點

zh-Hant

重點

  • 先認識人與流程，再定義系統。
  • 第一個版本只做最小可用的範圍，讓團隊真的用起來。
  • 每一個決定都寫成編號的決策紀錄。

TL;DR

  • Understand the people and the process before defining the system.
  • Ship the smallest useful version first, so the team actually uses it.
  • Write every decision down as a numbered decision record.

筆記

為什麼我們先談流程，再談技術

2026-10-078 分鐘Czesio

第一次見面，我們幾乎不談技術。我們問的是：一年後，您希望團隊少做哪三件事？

答案通常很具體

不想再對帳到半夜、不想再用三個試算表交接、不想再漏掉客人的訊息。這些答案會直接變成規格書的第一頁。

  • 流程寫成圖，而不是寫成文字。
  • 每一個取捨都寫成決策紀錄，例如 DR-014。

骨架錯了，後面再精緻的介面都只是在補洞。

接下來才是系統

理解之後才成形：先做出最小可用的版本，讓團隊真的用起來，再一起修。

en

Notes

Why we talk about process before technology

Oct 7, 20268 min readCzesio

At a first meeting, we barely talk about technology. We ask: a year from now, which three things should your team no longer have to do?

The answers are usually concrete

No more reconciling accounts at midnight, no more handing over work through three spreadsheets, no more missed messages from guests. Those answers become the first page of the spec.

  • Processes are drawn as diagrams, not written as paragraphs.
  • Every trade-off becomes a decision record, such as DR-014.

If the skeleton is wrong, even the finest interface is only patching holes.

Then comes the system

Shape follows understanding: ship the smallest useful version, let the team use it, then improve it together.
